counterfactual_missing_items: No raw span explicitly identifies the prostate lesion as a paraganglioma
No raw span confirms the left adrenal bed nodule is a paraganglioma
No raw span provides family history to confirm hereditary syndrome
decisive_items: 10-cm mass of the organ of Zukerkandl (1984)
Tumors positive for GATA3, tyrosine hydroxylase, chromogranin A, and synaptophysin
response.rationale: R4 is supported by raw evidence of an extra-adrenal organ of Zuckerkandl paraganglioma, a pathogenic SDHB variant, and neuroendocrine pathology; R1 only cites prostatic lesion growth and lacks raw evidence establishing prostatic paraganglioma identity, while ignoring the left adrenal bed nodule and prior paraganglioma history.
